quote.zh: 自日本引進工業微生物污染控制技術，從診斷、化驗、鑑定到治療與追蹤，達到有效控制。
quote.en: Industrial microbial control technology from Japan — from diagnosis, testing and identification to treatment and follow-up.

paragraphs.zh: 清泰源自日本引進工業微生物污染控制技術及進口微生物控制用藥劑商品。針對工廠的原料、製造過程、製成品或作業環境因微生物污染而提出改善對策。
paragraphs.en: GETX brought industrial microbial contamination control technology from Japan and imports microbial control agents. We propose corrective measures wherever microbes contaminate a factory's raw materials, manufacturing process, finished products or working environment.

paragraphs.zh: 同時對於小型的工作環境產生的微生物障礙，可以進行微生物污染診斷、異常分析化驗、鑑定及治療，並進一步作後續的追蹤檢測及加以改善，以達到有效的控制。
paragraphs.en: For microbial problems in smaller work environments, we carry out contamination diagnosis, analysis and testing of abnormalities, identification and treatment, followed by ongoing monitoring and improvement to keep contamination under effective control.

text.en: Trading of chemical raw materials, paper raw materials and additives, machinery and hardware

text.zh: 代理國內外廠商前各項有關產品報價投標業務
text.en: Quotation and tendering as agent for domestic and foreign manufacturers of the above products

text.en: Landscaping design and planning, and whole-plant equipment design and planning (excluding construction)

text.zh: 清潔劑、消毒用品及其器材之買賣
text.en: Trading of detergents, disinfectants and related equipment

text.zh: 殺蟲劑、殺菌劑、防腐劑、防黴劑（BIOTAC 拜歐泰克、BIODAN 拜歐丹）、防藻劑（NETKIN 耐特金）、防銹劑等環境衛生用藥之買賣
text.en: Trading of insecticides, biocides, preservatives, fungicides (BIOTAC, BIODAN), algaecides (NETKIN), rust inhibitors and other environmental sanitation agents
